review_notes: The native rear view shows both jaws retaining fabric with the line throughout the released hold. The front view is partly occluded by an arm; the rear view remains useful.
Both hands are open and clear. The garment is clear of the laundry board and table. Final native collision-hull separation from either arm exceeds 160 mm; board separation exceeds 70 mm.
The garment brushes the vertical side of the end post; it does not rest on its top or foot. Such incidental side contact does not substitute for either peg.
The garment bends, folds and sags during the trial. Its effective stiffness retains pronounced folds and is approximate. Tearing is not modelled; no visible material passage or other damage was seen.
Final native captures contain 52 and 93 material vertices. These corroborate the reviewed jaw images; a capture flag alone is not the judging rule.
